caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three gating configurations. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," starts at approximately 0.2 on layer 0 and decreases steadily, reaching near 0.0 by layer 5 and remaining flat through layer 22. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," begins at 1.0 on layer 0 and declines sharply, approaching the green dash-dot line near layer 10 at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.15, after which both lines stabilize. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at 1.0 on layer 0 and decreases sharply, converging with the orange dotted line near layer 10 at approximately 0.15, then stabilizing at a slightly higher sparsity ratio than the orange line for the remainder of the layers. The two lines after gate and after average gate do not intersect after layer 5.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The line chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three gating configurations. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," begins at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases sharply, reaching approximately 0.45 at layer 5, then continuing to decline to about 0.3 at layer 10, after which it fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.4 until layer 22. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases sharply, reaching approximately 0.6 at layer 5, then continues to decline to about 0.3 at layer 10, after which it fluctuates slightly between 0.1 and 0.2 until layer 22. The green dash-dot line remains above the orange dotted line for all layers beyond layer 5, and the two lines do not intersect after layer 5.
